pr_title: [Xbox] Fix crash when DisplayInformation it's called from other thread
pr_body:
## Description
[Xbox] Fix crash when `DisplayInformation::GetForCurrentView()` it's called from other thread

Fixes https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/issues/25015

## Motivation and context
As Microsoft says this method only is allowed in current thread (graphics thread):

> Gets the DisplayInformation instance associated with the current thread's CoreApplicationView. This DisplayInformation instance is tied to the view and cannot be used from other threads.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/uwp/api/windows.graphics.display.displayinformation.getforcurrentview?view=winrt-22621

This always is fulfilled except when is invoked from JSON Command (web interface / remote controls) that produces the crash.

As only is affected `IsHDRDisplay` and `HasSystemSdrPeakLuminance` and those are hardware/system related proprieties that is not expected to change during same execution, the fix consists on use cached values when is called from another thread (JSON Commands only).


## How has this been tested?
Runtime tested Xbox Series S querying settings with web interface Chorus2. 

Confirmed crash before and not crash after.

## What is the effect on users?
Fix crash on Xbox when retrieving Settings with JSON commands / remote control apps or web interface.

Added calls to `IsHDRDisplay()` and `HasSystemSdrPeakLuminance()` to make sure are cached a valid values when app starts.

i.e. prevents JSON commands may obtain wrong values if called early before of any other IsHDRDisplay() call

comments:
I tried to reproduce with Android Kore v3.1.0 and Xbox Series S and all works perfectly, no crash.

I not have any iPhone to test with it.

This crash is not triggered when using Kore's settings menu. Kore does not request the settings from Kodi, but only provides app-internal settings. The iOS remote app requests settings from Kodi server and you can use this to change settings inside Kodi. This is done via a JSON command (see above) which obviously lets the Kodi crash on Xbox.

OK I reproduced the crash with web interface Chorus2.

The crash is due DisplayInformation::GetForCurrentView() is called from other thread here:

https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/blob/f5128624a919f3198dd04fd909e6f7f3a3e7d0f2/xbmc/platform/win32/WIN32Util.cpp#L1341

I'm working on a fix.
Are the issues described in [this forum thread](https://forum.kodi.tv/showthread.php?tid=376991) having the same root cause?
No, this crash is related to HDR addition in v21 and in forum the user says crash was already in v20.... He should provide debug log.

> No, this crash is related to HDR addition in v21 and in forum the user says crash was already in v20.... He should provide debug log.
